scenario: `i1 overlaps i2` checks interval overlap per LINT.4.1 — true iff the ranges share at least one point (endpoints exclusive: adjacent intervals don't overlap per LINT.4.3). Pin: two Int intervals with `overlaps` compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Window scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    start: Int mutable
    end: Int mutable

rule r:
    Window a where a.entity_id == "a"
    Window b where b.entity_id == "b" and (a.start..a.end) overlaps (b.start..b.end)
->
    log info "overlap"
